- name: Install frontend dependencies
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix frontend

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov and cargo-nextest
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.88.1
        with:
          tool: cargo-llvm-cov@0.8.7,cargo-nextest@0.9.150

      - name: Verify coverage accumulation with the actual tool
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        # These fixtures launch real Cargo/rustc processes and share this job's
        # package cache. Give each compiler contract exclusive execution.
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/ci/backend-coverage.test.mjs scripts/ci/native-host-coverage.test.mjs scripts/ci/rust-profile.test.mjs scripts/ci/linux-crash-diagnostics.test.mjs scripts/ci/macos-remaining-cli.test.mjs

      - name: Build frontend
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm run build

      - name: Check built JavaScript for macOS 12 WKWebView
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm run check:build-syntax

      # Keep native lint, production builds and complete tests on every OS.
      - name: Clippy
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: src-tauri
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Build workspace
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: src-tauri
        run: cargo build --workspace --locked

      # Native Host coverage is independent of the remaining-workspace archive.
      - name: Test + coverage (macOS)
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: src-tauri
        shell: bash
        env:
          RUST_TEST_THREADS: 4
          NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS: 4
        run: |
          bash ../scripts/ci/workspace-coverage.sh macos-host
          # The independent archive lane owns every remaining default target.
          # Stable Rust doctests retain their original separate check.
          cargo test --workspace --doc

      - name: Upload test timing diagnostics
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' && (always() && env.MESH_TALK_TEST_TIMING == '1') }}
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: test-timing-macos-latest-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mesh-talk-test-timing.log
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' && (!(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'dev' && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]')) }}
        # Dependabot PRs to dev cannot read the Actions CODECOV_TOKEN secret.
        # Their tests still run; only the unauthenticated upload is skipped.
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
        with:
          version: v11.3.2
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: src-tauri/lcov.info
          name: workspace-macos-latest-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          # Branch protection requires codecov/patch; surface upload failures in CI too.
          fail_ci_if_error: true

        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' && (runner.os == 'Linux') }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          ulimit -c 262144
          node scripts/ci/linux-crash-diagnostics.mjs setup
          node scripts/ci/linux-crash-diagnostics.mjs selftest

      # Tauri reads frontendDist, so build the frontend before any Cargo step.
      - name: Build frontend
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm run build

      - name: Check built JavaScript for macOS 12 WKWebView
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm run check:build-syntax

      - name: Clippy
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: src-tauri
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Build workspace
        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: src-tauri
        run: cargo build --workspace --locked

      # Linux keeps its existing complete accumulated coverage and backend evidence.

        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        working-directory: src-tauri

        run: bash ../scripts/ci/workspace-coverage.sh linux --defer-report

        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}

        if: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
